dedupe_keys.name: ies building seismic response dataset sma 1 and qsis hybrid arrays 1999 2024 academia sinica taipei

description: This dataset holds nearly three decades of earthquake response recordings from the mid-rise reinforced concrete office building of the Institute of Earth Sciences (IES) at Academia Sinica in Taipei, Taiwan. It was published on Zenodo on 29 October 2025 by Utpal Kumar of the University of California, Berkeley. The building has a legacy network of 28 single-component SMA-1 strong-motion accelerographs, operating since the 1990s at 200 Hz in its Main and Library sections and the nearby free field, and an array of three-component Quake Structural Integrity System (QSIS) MEMS accelerometers installed in 2022, recording continuously at 100 Hz along the central axis of the Main section. Events include the 1999 Chi-Chi (Mw 7.6) and Chiayi (Mw 6.4) earthquakes and the 2024 Hualien earthquake (Mw 7.4), with many moderate events. Coverage is one instrumented building from 1999 to 2024. Access: one compressed archive of about 226 MB on Zenodo. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0; free. Caveats: one building; record formats are only in the archive, which was not opened. Simulation uses: tracking changes in structural dynamic properties under repeated shaking, and validating building response and monitoring models. Related records: the Bangkok tall building vibration data and the NEES shake table tests.
